fact: Minister Lephema says legal identity has strengthened the payroll system and eliminated ghost workers.

The IEC said its voter re-registration uses National Identification Cards as the sole form of identification, with registration open to all citizens aged 18 and above under the National Identity Card Act.

The Lesotho Times reports adopted electoral law amendments make the National Identity Document the basis for voter registration, with the roadmap scheduling registration and verification to intensify from October 2026.
The IEC said its voter registration system is integrated with the National Identity and Civil Registry through Unique Identification Numbers.
The IEC says the national voters' roll is registered on the national identity card as the sole form of identification.
